title: NIST WebBook: Propane is C3H8, molecular weight 44.0956 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Propane as C3H8, molecular weight 44.0956 amu, CAS 74-98-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Propane, CAS Registry Number 74-98-6, lists molecular formula C3H8 and molecular weight 44.0956 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 44.0626003 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C3H8/c1-3-2/h3H2,1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
